navigation.note: Door leaves are parked clear of portals. Furniture colliders are conservative AABBs. Clamp walking to walkBounds; floors/ceilings do not need collision testing.

lighting.recommendation: Use one shadowed directional key plus hemisphere fill. Emissive fixture geometry is included. Fixture positions support optional nearby point lights; enable only a few at once.
